prompt: Launch two Explore subagents in parallel with the Agent tool: one to list the files in this directory, one to read a.txt and report its contents. Do not read any files yourself. When both have reported, reply with the single word: done
source: Every stdout line of one real `claude` process run by hand in a scratch git repository holding a.txt and b.txt (the prompt above written to stdin as one stream-json user message, then stdin closed), with no Flux MCP config and no appended system prompt. Present: operator SessionStart hooks, `system/init`, two `Agent` tool_use blocks (subagent_type Explore) streamed as input_json_delta, `system/task_started` for each with `subagent_type`, `spawn_depth` and `prompt`, the subagent lines with `parent_tool_use_id` set to the Agent call's id (each subagent's prompt as a `user` line with text content, its `assistant` tool_use and its `user` tool_result; Claude Code emits no stream_event, no final assistant text and no result line for a subagent), `system/task_progress` and `system/task_updated` per task, `system/task_notification` with the subagent's report as `summary` and its `usage.total_tokens`, the parent's `tool_result` lines for the two Agent calls, the parent's closing `done` and the `result` with `subagent_stats`. Nothing was removed or edited: the run had no thinking blocks, so there were no signature_delta lines to drop.
